notes.title: Cultivation Tales Official S3 Season Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear fellow Taoists,
Cultivation Tales Official S2 Season will end at 10:00 on October 30, 2024, and will undergo a shutdown update. The official S3 season is expected to start at 10:00 on November 1.

===New Content===
1.【New season pass rewards】
The game's main body is priced at 68 yuan. By purchasing the main body, players can play cooperative mode and season mode, while unlocking regular passes.
（1）Regular version pass: You can obtain it by purchasing the main body. The regular pass reward for the S3 season includes two sets of limited edition "Ronghuofentian" fashion, After unlocking the pass, completing achievement tasks can earn rich game item rewards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/0dc8a0fba77402ca8851dea870209ba0436bf092.png

notes.title: Cultivation Tales Official S2 Season Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear fellow Taoists,
Cultivation Tales Official S1 Season will end at 24:00 on July 26, 2024, and will undergo a shutdown update. The official S2 season is expected to start at 10:00 on July 30.

===New Content===
1.【Weapon - Umbrella】
Fellow Taoists can obtain and use the brand new weapon "Umbrella", as well as new Five Elements moves and attacks waiting for everyone to experience!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/d9061923a025c14ade39ca86136e3f096dd7f128.png
2.【Hundred Ghosts Night Journey Gameplay】
Shared World has added a new gameplay called Hundred Ghosts Night Walk. Daoists can go to Shared World to view detailed instructions. Eliminate all ghosts, build arrow towers, and guard the wilderness.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/55ebcceb0ec7052352006c63e810288a703e4919.jpg
3.【New season pass rewards】
The game's main body is priced at 68 yuan. By purchasing the main body, players can play cooperative mode and season mode, while unlocking regular passes.
（1）Regular version pass: You can obtain it by purchasing the main body. The regular pass reward for the S2 season includes two sets of limited edition "Shuiyun" fashion, which can be upgraded to the advanced version of the pass. After unlocking the pass, completing achievement tasks can earn rich game item rewards.
（2）Advanced version pass: It can be upgraded from a regular pass and is priced at 38 yuan. The S2 Season Advanced Pass rewards include two sets of limited edition "Shui Yun" fashion and two sets of high-quality limited edition "Lan" fashion, as well as rewards for limited weapon appearances, title effects, and chat actions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/7e0a11676ecb714fa4ea22b9c86d801b195d075d.png

===Adjust and optimize the content===
1. Fixed the issue of abnormal return to the sect during the expedition
2. Fixed the issue of abnormal determination of expedition times
3. Fixed the issue of occasional abnormal departure time
4. Fixed the issue of occasional abnormal loading of skin models
5. Fixed the issue of occasional falling objects not being successfully picked up

notes.title: Cultivation Tales Official S1 Season Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear fellow Taoists,
The S7 season of the early trial version of "Cultivation Tales" will end at 10:00 on April 17, 2024, and there will be a shutdown update. The official S1 season is expected to start at 10:00 on April 18.

===New content===
1. [Instrument Spirit System]
Players can use this system to enhance their weapon abilities, obtain attribute enhancements, and ultimately have a chance to obtain more powerful evolved moves! Add a consumable item called "Artifact Spirit", which can be produced by adding a dungeon called "Sword Tomb" and support free trading;
Add a new wild dungeon called "Sword Tomb", challenge dungeons and defeat lords to obtain artifact spirits.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/44de3d51c942fa680966874c7d74661f7649e6de.png
2. [Cross Season Inheritance System - Sanshengshi]
At the Three Lives Stone, players can store some of their cultivation, moves, spells, and equipment from this season until the next season, and choose to spend a certain cost to take them out and inherit them in the next season. The cultivation motivation is even stronger every season!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/56ba7577365d637bfe8405420e4c596904627c4b.jpg
3. [Expedition Gameplay - Thunder Formation]
The attacking side has added a "Thunder Formation", which can be deployed and summon Thunder Formation puppets to assist in the attack. The battle between the attacking and defending sides will become even more intense!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/3060904c67737d5519ae67fcc60c042f4c08d1f7.jpg
4. [Arena gameplay]
Add an arena on the second floor of the Five Elements Tower. 1V1 competitive confrontation, enjoy the fun of battle to the fullest; Win with pride, compete for higher point rankings, and earn honors to exchange for generous rewards!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/ae86031c5d12535349cd6baabc8264addf550fa9.png
5. Rewards for new season passes
The game's main body is priced at 68 yuan. By purchasing the main body, players can play in both cooperative and season modes, while unlocking a regular pass.
(1) Regular version pass: You can obtain it by purchasing the main body. The S1 season regular pass reward includes two sets of limited "flying" fashion, which can be upgraded to the advanced version of the pass. After unlocking the pass, completing achievement tasks can earn rich game item rewards.
(2) Advanced version of the pass: It can be upgraded from a regular pass and is priced at 38 yuan. The S1 season advanced pass rewards include two sets of limited "flying" fashion and two sets of high-quality limited "snake" fashion, as well as rewards for limited weapon appearance, title special effects, and chat actions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/9cd68a52ffe25b5353711ed0248b9f3fd6003efc.png

===Adjusting and optimizing content===
1. Adjust the departure time: The departure time will be changed to 18:00-23:00.
2. Cancel the trading bank system and gift function.
3. The recharge entrance and the first recharge activity are activated.

After the official S1 season update, a massive number of welfare activities will be launched simultaneously. Rich rewards such as treasure chests, limited titles, spirit stones, opening orders, and massive game resources are waiting for everyone to participate! Stay tuned for our upcoming event announcements~
Thank you all for your support and trust. Looking forward to meeting everyone in tales in the official S1 season!

notes.title: Cultivation Tales Official Release
S7 Season Update Announcement
notes.notes:
===S7 Season Begins===
The S6 season is about to end at 10:00 am on November 10, 2023. At that time, the honor values of this season will be settled. The new season S7 will start after this version update, and the specific service opening time will be subject to further announcement and notification
===New content===
1. [Legend Blacksmith Enhancement System]:
Players can enhance their Xianyuan equipment (non weapons) through this system, which can more effectively enhance their strength. The addition of enhanced consumption items such as Fairy Edge Stone and Enhanced Protection Scroll will also be produced through in-game channels, and free trading is also supported!
 {STEAP_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/378cec89956683d49cbbcae0b02b5f7d3d1a3746.png 
2. [New Season Pass Rewards]:
Free unlocking of ordinary pass allows you to obtain a set of Huangyuan Demon Feather skin for both men and women;
The price of the advanced pass is 38 yuan. The advanced pass can receive a set of Bloody Orchid Creek Fashion for men and women, two handed swords, dragon slaying skin, phoenix titles, etc;
 {STEAP_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/db090854983a619945997 CD4d585b9d7417707e8. png 
===Adjusting and optimizing content===
1. Add equipment to enhance the consumption of the item "Immortal Edge Stone": used in the Blacksmith's enhancement area, it can enhance the Immortal Yuan equipment (not weapons), and successful enhancement can increase the "Enhanced Damage" attribute.
2. New equipment enhancement consumption item "Enhancement Protection Scroll": used when equipment enhancement+10 or above, it can protect equipment from being destroyed in the event of enhancement failure.
3. Underwater Secret Realm, World Merchants add Fairy Edge Stone drops and gains.
4. World merchants and Thunder Array have added enhanced protection scrolls for drop and acquisition.
5. New resolution adaptation 3840 * 2160
6. Add an interface prompt after a character dies due to regional spiritual pressure
7. Fixed the issue of replaceable equipment in the shared world
8. Fixed the issue of occasional characters falling into Kyushu underground and causing death
9. Fix occasional issues where the divine tree becomes level 1 after being hit
10. Fix the problem of abnormal locking of carved stones in extreme situations
11. Fixed the issue of carrying 11th level Soul Swallowing to enter Ozawa character death
12. Fixed the issue of building placement, material consumption, but target building not displaying
13. Fix the problem of not being able to regenerate after the death of the square competition
14. Fixed the issue of abnormal health display for World Lords
15. Fixed the issue of abnormal display of score board information during the Zongmen War
16. Fixed the issue where the sect clicked to launch after using the Breath Drum Rune, but the effect of the Breath Drum Rune did not end immediately
17. Fixed issue where Soul Devouring Inheritance skill did not cause damage to monsters

notes.title: Regional service update announcement on May 10
notes.notes:
Regional service update announcement on May 10

Dear players

Due to the scheduled launch of PVP at 14 o'clock today, the client update needs to be prepared in advance. The service will be stopped and updated at about 13:30. The estimated time of stopping service is half an hour. However, the notice bar in the game fails to inform you in time. I hope you can save the progress in time to avoid unnecessary losses. After the update is completed, you can log in to the game again

The version number after this maintenance is 0.98.





The production team of "too wasteland"

May 10, 2022

notes.title: The official apologized for the server problem in the release of "too wasteland"
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you very much for your attention and support. On behalf of the production team, I would like to extend my most sincere apology for the server accident on the release day!

Thank you for your feedback to the players who support the purchase for the first time and then give a bad refund. I'm very sorry to bring you a bad experience. The production team never dreamed that the players were so enthusiastic about our game that we made a serious mistake in estimating the number of players, resulting in a server crash. This is our problem. You are right. After our game is improved, you are welcome to return at any time.

For the players who have been patient and tolerant to us so far, thank you for your support. We promise that as long as the game doesn't die, we will always pay attention to the feedback and improvement of players, Polish slowly and update frequently, and live up to your expectations.

Today, many players can't log in because they receive the "version is too low" prompt when logging in. For this, we have made urgent troubleshooting and repair for the problem. At present, the pressure bearing capacity of the server has temporarily reached a balanced state, and players can log in normally. We are also working hard to solve the problem of waiting in line. I'm very sorry for the inconvenience caused to players by the forbidden behavior of the official QQ group before. Please believe that our original intention is not a cold prohibition, but an emergency. The first reaction is to avoid swiping the screen and let players miss the notice uniformly sent by the administrator. I hope you will understand!

Thank you again for your tolerance and support for "Taihuang Chujing". I'm ashamed that our small studio has limited capacity. After today's events, I don't dare to boast that there are no problems at all, but what we can guarantee is that we will actively collect feedback and try our best to solve and improve problems at the first time. As long as we can live, we will update the game until the producer is bald and the studio can't live!

We hereby declare that we will not run away! Can't run! Can't run!

For the experience impact caused by this accident, we have brainstormed the compensation scheme for players, and we will give back to you to apologize at that time.

Thank you again for your tolerance and support!
